bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $277，位于 52 周低点

read.en: Alphabet fell 3.5% on Nov 19 to $272.66, reversing from a $295.43 high to a $272.36 low, its lowest close in 52 weeks. It is below the 5-day ($283.0, falling), 10-day ($286.7, rising), 30-day ($309.4), 100-day ($335.7) and 200-day ($337.3), all three falling. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, but the histogram is fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($303.92), and RSI is 30.6.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月19日下跌 3.5%，收于 $272.66，自 $295.43 高点回落至 $272.36 低点，为 52 周最低收盘。股价位于 5 日（$283.0，下行）、10 日（$286.7，上行）、30 日（$309.4）、100 日（$335.7）和 200 日均线（$337.3）下方，后三者均在下行。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，但柱状图收窄、接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 11月17日起看空（$303.92），RSI 为 30.6。

read.en: The close broke the $276.9–279.7 support (Oct 30, Nov 5, 17 and 18 lows), now resistance, after the $295.43 high was rejected at the Nov 16 high. Resistance is $276.9–280.2, then $282.4–283.7 (5-day, Nov 16 and 18 closes) and $286.7–288.2 (10-day, Nov 10 and 9 closes). Support is $272.1–273.5 (52-week low, Mar 30), then $270–270.7 (Nov 14, 2025 low). A close above $280.2 would target $283.7; below $272.1, $270.

r.en: Oct 30 low $276.92; Nov 5 low $277.07; Nov 17 low $278.46; Nov 17 close $280.20, lost
